title: Smart Water Dispenser System
summary: ESP32 devices, RFID authentication and mobile money joined by a secure API, designed offline-first for places where the network isn’t a given.
problem: Water access points in low-connectivity areas need to authenticate users, meter usage and take payment, without assuming the network is up when someone turns the tap.
approach: Treat the device as the source of truth while offline and the cloud as the reconciler: authenticate and meter at the edge, queue transactions locally, and sync when connectivity returns.
highlights: Architected an IoT and cloud system joining ESP32 devices, RFID authentication and mobile money.
Defined the end-to-end flows: payments, credit and water usage tracking.
Modelled a transaction-heavy PostgreSQL schema and recommended time-series storage for telemetry.
Designed the secure API layer between devices, admin dashboards and the mobile portal.
Conceptualised a React admin dashboard and a mobile-friendly portal for balance checks and top-ups.
Evaluated and planned the mobile money integrations.
Specified a fault-tolerant, offline-first edge approach.

outcome.label: Scope
outcome.value: End-to-end system design: payments, credit, usage

note: Brought in to architect and plan, not to implement. The deliverable was a design the client’s team could execute.
